key_insight: ClinFusion is a vision-centric multimodal LLM that combines 2D and 3D medical image understanding with clinically aligned evaluation to improve holistic medical understanding.
clinical_relevance: It could help support radiology workflows by generating better image-grounded reports, answering clinical questions, and handling mixed imaging modalities more reliably.
method: Cascade Spatial-Aware Locality Fusion encoder to merge diverse 2D and native 3D image features
RoI-grounded report evaluation designed to better match radiologist judgment
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art results across 24 benchmarks, with stronger performance than leading open-source and some proprietary MLLMs, plus blinded radiologist review supporting its report quality and metric validity.
watch_item: Despite strong benchmark results, real-world clinical deployment still needs careful validation for safety, generalization across hospitals, and robust performance on unseen cases.
paper_title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
